figurative_meaning_bn: প্রতিভা ও মৌলিকতার অভাবহেতু অপরের রচনা অনুকরণ
figurative_meaning_en: Imitation of others' works due to lack of talent and originality
similar_in_english: Chewing the cud (in a derivative sense)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উপন্যাস চর্বিতচর্বণ মাত্র, কোনো নতুনত্ব নেই।
সাহিত্যে চর্বিতচর্বণ করে সে কখনো সফল হবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His novel is nothing but chewed cud, with no originality whatsoever.
In literature, mere imitation like chewing the cud will never lead to success.
history: Derived from Sanskrit term implying repeated chewing, akin to rumination, metaphorically used in Bengali literature for derivative works.
note: This idiom is often used in literary criticism to denote unoriginal replication.
